question: When the already-frozen two-year BTC 4h completed-shape retrieval is expanded from Top-8 to Top-20 per side, which additional ranks 9-20 should the Owner review?
universe_rule: Exactly the baseline v1 rule: for each okx_*_USDT_SWAP_15m_*.csv in data/kline_deep, choose the longest declared-row snapshot; require exactly 54 unique symbols; resample only complete 16x15m UTC buckets and merge one bounded public OKX 4H page after exact OHLC overlap parity.
single_variable: top_per_side changes from 8 to 20. Protocol, universe, dates, reference, 30+12+6 window, gates, feature scales, weights, RMSE, DTW, deduplication, shortlist and null random seed remain byte-for-byte equivalent to baseline v1.

expansion_contract.required_post_scan_gate: Ranks 1-8 on each side must retain exact event identity and coarse/DTW/final distances within absolute tolerance 1e-12 before any new rank is delivered.

ranking_contract.rerank_stage: Exact multivariate DTW with Sakoe-Chiba radius 2, computed separately on the 30-bar prelude and 12-bar release; 35% prelude plus 65% release.
ranking_contract.final_distance: 45% coarse plus 55% split-DTW; lower is more similar and is not a probability.
ranking_contract.exclusion_zone: Within one symbol and direction, anchors within 18 bars are one event neighborhood; keep the lowest final distance.
ranking_contract.selection: Return exactly twenty non-overlapping LONG and twenty non-overlapping SHORT candidates if available. Ranks 9-20 are the new Owner-facing review batch; ranks 1-8 are retained only for exact prefix parity.

null_control.method: Keep the exact 30-bar reference prelude and the same multivariate set of 12 release rows, but randomly permute the release-row order 200 times. Compare each null query's deduplicated Top-20 coarse mean distance with the real query.
null_control.null_hypothesis: The temporal ordering of the supplied release is no more retrievable than the same amplitudes and channel values in random release order.
null_control.p_value: One-sided lower-is-better randomization p with plus-one correction. This changed Top-20 estimand is descriptive and does not overwrite the baseline Top-8 p-value.

holdout.authorization_scope: After being told that ranks beyond 8 were not persisted and that regenerating ranks 9-20 would reread about 36,720 holdout 4h symbol-rows as configuration use #2, the Owner replied '继续' on 2026-08-25.
holdout.post_result_rule: Do not tune gates, weights, windows, DTW radius, deduplication, shortlist or Top-N after seeing this scan. Any further expansion or changed configuration requires a new Owner authorization and consumption number.

delivery_contract.visual: One 48-bar candle-plus-six-MA chart per row, with a blue release-start line, gray 12-bar match-end line and six review-only bars, plus a contact sheet and HTML gallery.
